name: TeachCL Python
postCreateCommand: if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt; elif [ -f visualization_feedback_scripts_py/requirements.txt ]; then python -m venv visualization_feedback_scripts_py/.venv && visualization_feedback_scripts_py/.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && visualization_feedback_scripts_py/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r visualization_feedback_scripts_py/requirements.txt; elif [ -f visualization_scripts/requirements.txt ]; then python -m venv visualization_scripts/.venv && visualization_scripts/.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && visualization_scripts/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r visualization_scripts/requirements.txt; else echo 'requirements.txt not found'; exit 1; fi
postAttachCommand: if [ -f app.py ]; then .venv/bin/python -m streamlit run app.py --server.address 0.0.0.0 --server.port 8501 --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false; elif [ -f visualization_feedback_scripts_py/app.py ]; then visualization_feedback_scripts_py/.venv/bin/python -m streamlit run visualization_feedback_scripts_py/app.py --server.address 0.0.0.0 --server.port 8501 --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false; elif [ -f visualization_scripts/app.py ]; then visualization_scripts/.venv/bin/python -m streamlit run visualization_scripts/app.py --server.address 0.0.0.0 --server.port 8501 --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false; else echo 'app.py not found'; fi
